control.title: Contact with authorities, CERT-In point of contact
control.description: Keep a current list of authority contacts (CERT-In, Data Protection Board, sector regulator, police cyber cell), designate a CERT-In Point of Contact, and maintain memberships of security interest groups.

implementation_notes: Implemented at Paisa Setu Fintech and reviewed annually.
evidence_hint: Authority contact list, CERT-In PoC designation, record of PoC details shared with CERT-In.
acceptance_criteria: A contact list for authorities (CERT-In, police, regulators) exists and is current
A CERT-In point of contact is designated, with a record that the details were shared with CERT-In

requirements.title: Designate a Point of Contact for CERT-In
requirements.guidance: Designate a Point of Contact to interface with CERT-In and share their details in the prescribed format. Keep the details current.

requirements.title: Provide information and assistance when ordered
requirements.guidance: When CERT-In issues an order or direction, provide the requested information or assistance within the stated time.

requirements.title: Register with FIU-IND
requirements.guidance: Non-bank PAs register with the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU-IND).

requirements.title: Contact with authorities
requirements.guidance: Maintain contacts with regulators and authorities such as CERT-In and law enforcement.

requirements.title: Contact with special interest groups
requirements.guidance: Maintain contacts with security forums and professional groups.
